theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (D : Set (Euclidean N)) (f : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), 0 < s → ∫⁻ x in D, f x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * ∫⁻ w in {w : Euclidean N | s • w ∈ D}, f (s • w) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
